builds.title: Flappy AI Jam Starter
builds.description: The gentle three-life starter. Flap through the gaps with Space, the up arrow or tap.

builds.title: Autopilot
builds.description: Watch the game plan its own flight path, then switch the autopilot off and try it yourself.
builds.prompt: Add an autopilot that plans flap-or-coast decisions using the game’s fixed-step physics. Draw its predicted flight path and let me switch back to manual controls. Keep the demo in continuous practice.

builds.title: Voice flight
builds.description: Flap with Space, tap, or your voice. The mic is optional and sound stays on your device.
builds.prompt: Use the browser microphone locally to flap when I speak. Show a spectrum behind the game, and keep Space and tap working if the mic is unavailable. Use wide gaps and recovery so visitors can keep playing.

builds.title: Boss rush
builds.description: Meet the boss straight away. Dash through a wave, then fly through the gates. Bumps let you keep going.
builds.prompt: Add a Shift or on-screen dash that gives a short shield. Show a slow, clearly signalled boss wave at the start, then alternate gates and boss waves. Let the player recover after bumps for live demos.
